# Claude Code

The repository is a Claude Code plugin (skills + MCP server) and its own marketplace.

```text
/plugin marketplace add Webuddhist-tech/buddhist-creator-connector
/plugin install buddhist-creator-connector@webuddhist
```

Claude Code will prompt for your WeBuddhist Library API key and store it in your secure credential store. The plugin then runs the connector locally with `npx -y @webuddhist/connector-server`.

Validate a local checkout before publishing:

```bash
claude plugin validate .
```
